APEC-wide mapping diagnostics

Structural checks start from the summed APEC balance. Economy evidence is calculated only for failed APEC anchors. Updated: 2026-08-23 11:36 JST
Canonical hierarchy contract build: 9c566a5474aa409f

How to read a hierarchy case

Manual LEAP roll-upOnly constructed LEAP subtotal branches receive this label; they are compared with their immediate source-tree children.
One-to-many fan-outOne raw parent can reach several ESTO components. Those routes are not additional source-tree parents.
De-duplicated frontierMapped component rows can overlap. The frontier counts each Common ESTO row once, so do not add the displayed component rows.
Raw source contradictionIf a raw parent is 0 while its children are non-zero, the original source hierarchy disagrees with itself. It is not, by itself, a missing mapping.

LEAP ESTO Extended cases are currently suppressed. 240 LEAP anchor contexts contain child mappings that belong to an ESTO Extended scope. They are excluded until the detailed LEAP sectors are fully imported into the main LEAP areas; the page does not treat their absent detail as a mapping failure.

Imported LEAP category recognition

LEAP labels are retained after known aliases are normalised. A category is marked for review here when a non-zero LEAP flow/product pair has no direct maintained LEAP-to-ESTO mapping; this does not mean that its source label is invalid. 383 non-zero pair(s) need review. Open Direct mapping coverage review → Non-zero unmapped LEAP branches for the pairs and any indirect ESTO lead.

All rollup boundaries

Mapping-owned rollup edges across every ESTO flow. Green means a rolled value equals its contributors within tolerance; red means it does not. Values aggregate all products for the chosen source, scenario, and year.

All sector rollup structure

Start with the collapsed major-sector overview, choose a sector, or search for a flow. EXPANDING rollups appear in the hierarchy view by default. Tick the special-rollup checkbox to add NON_EXPANDING and DETACHED targets and display relationships; detailed rule definitions remain in the tables on this page.

Normal hierarchyA solid blue arrow means the child has the displayed parent in the ESTO flow tree.
Registered rollupA dotted ochre arrow shows display membership in a compiled comparison boundary; the target box identifies its rollup mode.
NON_EXPANDING vs DETACHEDNON_EXPANDING replaces a comparison frontier without adding another hierarchy branch. DETACHED remains outside ordinary ancestor totals and is intentional, not an orphan.
ESTO ExtendedExtended-only rows are purple. Include them only when you need to inspect the extension; values always come from the selected dataset.
Showing original ESTO structure
normal hierarchyrollup display relationshipintentional DETACHED boundaryPurple node = Extended-only addition; red = orphan, duplicate, inconsistency, or failed validation.
Click a node to highlight its parent, children, and rollup relationships. Choose a major sector (or click one) to expand it.
